---
title: "Example report"
subtitle: "Mock expression data: treated vs. control"
---

{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
source("scripts/R/provenance.R")
out <- report_dir()   # this report's folder in output/reports/latest/: save its figures and tables there
```

## Data

```{r}
samples <- tar_read(samples)
samples
```

`r nrow(tar_read(counts))` genes measured in `r nrow(samples)` samples, normalised to log2 counts per million.

## Genes that change most

```{r}
top <- head(tar_read(gene_summary), 20)
write.csv(top, file.path(out, "top-genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
top
```

## Treated vs. control

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Mean expression per condition; red: genes changing more than two-fold."
p <- tar_read(gene_plot)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out, "treated-vs-control.png"), p, width = 6, height = 5)
p
```
